From 9648f1c3739505557d94ff749a4f32192ea81fe3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Feb 2022 10:15:04 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/guc/slpc: Correct the param count for unset param

SLPC unset param H2G only needs one parameter - the id of the
param.

Fixes: 025cb07bebfa ("drm/i915/guc/slpc: Cache platform frequency limits")

Suggested-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ramalingam C <ramalingam.c@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20220216181504.7155-1-vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
index 13b27b8ff74e..ba21ace973da 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
@@ -110,7 +110,7 @@ static int guc_action_slpc_unset_param(struct intel_guc *guc, u8 id)
 {
 	u32 request[] = {
 		GUC_ACTION_HOST2GUC_PC_SLPC_REQUEST,
-		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
+		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
 		id,
 	};
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c`**
   - The function `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` was modified to change the second argument of the `SLPC_EVENT` macro from `2` to `1`. This change reflects that the SLPC unset parameter H2G only requires one parameter, which is the ID of the parameter being unset.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `intel_guc_slpc.c` corrects the parameter count for the SLPC unset parameter action, aligning it with the intended functionality as indicated in the patch description. This change addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `025cb07bebfa`), which incorrectly set the parameter count to `2` instead of the correct value of `1`. The patch is part of an ongoing effort to ensure the correct operation of the SLPC functionality within the Intel graphics driver.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915/guc/slpc: Correct the param count for unset param

SLPC unset param H2G only needs one parameter - the id of the
param.

Fixes: 025cb07bebfa ("drm/i915/guc/slpc: Cache platform frequency limits")

Suggested-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ramalingam C <ramalingam.c@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20220216181504.7155-1-vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrectly specifying the number of parameters required for the SLPC unset parameter action in the `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` function. The code originally set the parameter count to `2`, which was incorrect as only one parameter (the ID of the parameter to unset) is needed. This mismatch could lead to improper handling of the unset action, potentially causing failures or unexpected behavior in the SLPC functionality.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int guc_action_slpc_unset_param(struct intel_guc *guc, u8 id)
 {
 	u32 request[] = {
 		GUC_ACTION_HOST2GUC_PC_SLPC_REQUEST,
-		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
+		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
 		id,
 	};
 
 	return intel_guc_send(guc, request, ARRAY_SIZE(request));
 }

```c

```
Reason:
The parameter count was incorrectly set to `2` in the `SLPC_EVENT` macro, which indicates that two parameters were expected for the unset action. This mismatch caused the function to potentially handle the unset action improperly, leading to failures or unexpected behavior in the SLPC functionality.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
```
Reason:
The parameter count is corrected to `1`, which accurately reflects the requirement that only the ID of the parameter to unset is needed. This change ensures that the unset action is handled correctly, preventing the issues caused by the previous incorrect parameter count.
